questions.question: If a shopkeeper sells an item that is marked as Rs. 3685 for Rs. 2845, then how much discount is he offering ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper sells an item that is marked as Rs. 3685 for Rs. 2845

**Formula used:**

%discount = [(Mark price – Selling price)/Mark price] × 100

**Calculation:**

Mark Price (M.P.) = 3685

Selling price (S.P.) = 2845

%discount = [(M.P. –S.P.)/M.P.] × 100

⇒ [(3685 – 2845)/3685] × 100

⇒ (840/3685) × 100

⇒ 840 × 20/737 = 22.795%

**∴ The discount offer is 22.795%.**

questions.question: If Sec A = 5/3, then what is the value of Cot A ?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

SecA = 5/3

**Formula used:**

Sec²A – Tan²A = 1,

CotA = 1/TanA

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sec²A – Tan²A =1

⇒ Tan²A =Sec²A – 1

⇒ Tan²A = (5/3)² – 1

⇒ Tan²A = (25 – 9)/9

⇒ Tan²A = 16/9

⇒ TanA = 4/3

⇒ CotA = 1/TanA

⇒ CotA = 1/(4/3)

⇒ **CotA = 3/4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

SecA = 5/3

SecA = hypotenius / base

SecA = AC/BC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4245afc73d019c58b9d5ffb58afea48416264b1760dca6a64df1eca953faaf38.png] 

In triangle ABC ∠ B = 90⁰

Using pythagorus theorem

⇒ (AC)² = (AB)² + (BC)²

⇒ (5)² = (3)² + (AB)²

⇒ (AB)² = 25 – 9

⇒ (AB)² = 16

⇒ AB = √ 16

⇒ AB = 4

Then, TanA = Perpendicular/Base

⇒ TanA = AB/BC

⇒ TanA = 4/3

questions.question: Three sides of a triangle measure 6 cm, 10 cm and x cm. The minimum integral value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

one side of triangle = 6 cm

second side of triangle = 10 cm

**concept used:**

the difference of two other sides < x < sum of two other side

**calculation:**

(10 - 6) < x < (10 + 6)

⇒ 4 < x < 16

the third side of the triangle should lie between 4 and 16

∴ minimum integral value is 5 and maximum integral value is 15

**Hence, the answer is 5 cm**

questions.question: A man took a loan from a bank at the rate of 11% p.a. simple interest. After three years, he had to pay Rs. 9570 interest only for the period. The principal amount borrowed by him was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 11%

Time = 3 years

Simple interest(S.I) = Rs. 9570

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **P = (S.I × 100)/(R × T)

⇒ P = (9570 × 100)/(11 × 3)

⇒ P = 29000

**∴ The principal amount borrowed by him was Rs. 29000.**

questions.question: The equation of a straight line on a point (3, -5) and slope 2 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The equation of a straight line on a point (3, -5)

The slope of a line is 2.

**Formula use:**

⇒ (y - y₁) = m(x - x₁)

⇒ m = slope of a line, and (x₁, y₁)

**Calculation:**

⇒ x₁ = 3, y₁ = -5

According to the formula

⇒ y - (-5) = 2 × (x - 3)

⇒ y + 5 = 2x -6

⇒ 2x - y - 11 = 0

**∴ The equation of line is 2x - y - 11 = 0.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

The equation of a straight line passing through two points A (x₁, y₁) and B (x₂, y₂) is given by 

⇒ (y - y₁) = ((y₂ - y₁)/ (x₂ - x₁)) × (x - x₁)

Its slope (m) = (y2 - y1)/ (x2 - x1).

questions.question: How much time (in minutes) will a dog take to run around a square field of side 75 m if it runs at the rate of 6 km/hr?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Square of side = 75 m

And a dog runs around the square with a speed of = 6 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

The perimeter of a square = 4 × side of the given square

**Calculation:**

⇒ Speed of the dog in m/sec = 6 × 1000/3600 = 6× 5/18 **= 5/3 m/sec**

⇒ The perimeter of the Square = 4 × 75 m = **300 m**

⇒ Time = Distance/speed

Hence, Time is taken by the dog to travel around the square

⇒ Time = (300)/(5/3) = 60 × 3 seconds or (60 × 3)/60 = **3 minutes**

questions.question: The ratio of present ages (in years) of a father and son is 15 : 8. Six years ago, the ratio of their ages was 13 : 6 What is the father's present age ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of present ages (in years) of a father and son is 15 : 8. Six years ago.

And the ratio of their ages was 13 : 6.

**Calculation: **

Let the present age of father be 15x years.

And the present age of son be 8x years.

According to the question:

(15x – 6)/(8x – 6 ) = 13/6

⇒ 90x – 36 = 104x – 78

⇒ - 14x = - 42

⇒ x = 3

**∴ The present age of father is 15x years = 15 × 3 = 45 years.**
